title: Tanvi Patri Wins U17 Title at Badminton Asia Junior Championships
indian_angle: An Indian player won a significant continental junior title in an all-Indian final, showcasing the depth of talent.
summary: Odisha's Tanvi Patri defeated fellow Indian Shaina Manimuthu in an all-Indian final to clinch the U17 title at the Badminton Asia Junior Championships with a score of 11-15, 15-10, 15-12.

title: Pramod Bhagat Bags Gold and Silver, Sukant Kadam Reaches 100-Medal Milestone
indian_angle: Indian para-badminton stars Pramod Bhagat and Sukant Kadam achieved significant milestones at an event in Japan, bringing glory to the nation.
summary: Indian para-badminton ace Pramod Bhagat secured a gold and a silver medal, while his compatriot Sukant Kadam achieved a remarkable career milestone of 100 international medals at a tournament in Japan.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Begins in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is vital for enhancing the quality of badminton coaching across India, directly impacting future player development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is conducting its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: The regulations for the 2026 Inter State Team Championships, a crucial domestic event, have been released, setting the stage for state-level competition.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has published the regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for the national team competition.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp prepares India's promising young talent for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships, aiming for international success.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will be implemented across U13, U15, and U17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships, impacting junior player development and match dynamics in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
